arg.name: use_sim_time
arg.description: Whether or not to use the simulated clock.

arg.name: tip_link
arg.description: Tip link the RoboPlan planning server plans for.

arg.name: record_rosbags
arg.description: Whether to start a dormant rosbag recorder, needed by the connector_mate_tests tree.

executable.cmd: ros2 bag record --start-paused --disable-keyboard-controls --node-name rosbag_recorder --storage mcap --use-sim-time --output $(command 'mktemp -u -t rosbag_recorder_XXXXXX') --topics /force_torque_sensor_broadcaster/wrench /joint_states /tf /tf_static /admittance_controller/status
